content:
After an unusually long three-week wait, new betas for the developer versions are officially rolling out, including iPadOS 27 beta 5. Here are the details.

iPadOS 27 beta 5 and other Apple updates have been released

With less than a month to go until the official public release of iOS 27, this typically signals that the beta release cycle is about to accelerate.

Apple today released beta 5 across multiple platforms, including iPadOS 27, watchOS 27, tvOS 27, and visionOS 27.

For now, only developers can download and install the new updates. However, if Apple follows its usual approach, public beta versions of the same software should be available within about a day.

At this stage of the beta cycle, we don't expect to find any major user interface changes in Apple's software. Instead, two main things typically happen to Apple's betas in August:

  • New betas will be released more frequently, usually once a week, but with noticeably fewer changes
  • Apple's focus will shift to bug fixes and performance improvements

Apple has emphasized that new versions like iOS 27 will offer performance improvements over the previous generation.

Although this has been the case to some extent in the beta versions, you can expect Apple's new software to run even more smoothly over beta 5 and the coming weeks, with more bugs being fixed.

That said, if there are any new features or notable changes in today's update, we'll let you know.

Have you found anything new in iPadOS 27 beta 5 or any other version? Feel free to share with us in the comments section.
